Innovation through formulation.

# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]
* [Our sustainability policies][8

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is

Employment Opportunities
Working at Azelis

We embrace change as an invaluable opportunity to grow, learn and become even better at what we do.
As do our people. Azelis currently employs more than 4,100 talented individuals in 64 countries. And
counting.

 

[Working at Azelis ][87][Talent Mobility ][88]

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

### Work with us

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

[Discover our career opportunities][94]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains. 

[Learn more][95]
We provide high quality raw materials, sourced from leading global manufacturers. Our technical team
can provide you with sampling, formulation and expertise.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now

  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

Anmol Chemicals manufactures a range of pharmaceuticals, including active pharmaceutical ingredients
and excipients, in accordance with BP/EP/USP-NF/IP and international pharmaceutical standards.
Modern manufacturing facilities in Anmol are able to offer material that is specifically customized
to meet any technical or particle size requirements.

[ View More][33]

Anmol Chemicals specialize in manufacturing high-quality vitamin ingredients that meet global
standards for purity, safety and performance. With decades of expertise in fine chemicals, we
deliver reliable, consistent vitamin grades used across pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, food, feed
and cosmetic industries.

Anmol Chemicals manufactures a wide range of nutraceuticals. The term “Nutraceutical” combines the
two words of “Nutrient,” which is a nourishing food component, and “Pharmaceutical,” which is a
medical drug.

[View More][37]

Anmol Chemicals manufactures a wide spectrum of speciality chemicals and is known for its culture of
innovation, which frequently updates and introduces high-performing functional compounds. This
product line is customer-focused and application-specific, and it is employed in a variety of end
use areas.

[View More][39]

### Safety Basics

Safety is the most critical consideration when caring for yourself and your family. Nothing else
matters if you can’t believe in a product and rely on it to do what it says. Product safety is a top
priority of cosmetics and personal care products companies, and everything they do is grounded in
the best science available. In the U.S., cosmetics and personal care products are regulated by the
Food & Drug Administration (FDA) under the Food, Drug & Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), the Fair Packaging
& Labeling Act (FPLA) and the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) of 2022.

expiration dates on the labels of cosmetics and personal care products. However, they are required

CosmeticsInfo.org is your source for information about cosmetics and personal care products that you
and your family trust and rely on every day. Browse and learn more about how these products work,
their safety and the science behind commonly used ingredients.

### Safety Basics

Safety is the most critical consideration when caring for yourself and your family. Nothing else
matters if you can’t believe in a product and rely on it to do what it says. Product safety is a top
priority of cosmetics and personal care products companies, and everything they do is grounded in
the best science available. In the U.S., cosmetics and personal care products are regulated by the
Food & Drug Administration (FDA) under the Food, Drug & Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), the Fair Packaging
& Labeling Act (FPLA) and the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) of 2022.

exposure for a “perfect tan.”

No regulations or requirements under current U.S. law require manufacturers to print specific
expiration dates on the labels of cosmetics and personal care products. However, they are required
to determine shelf life as part of their responsibility to substantiate safety. Learn about product
shelf life and how it affects safety.

laundry detergents. Formulators planning a sodium laureth sulfate buy can source standard SLES 70%
in both 2EO and 3EO variants, with other active levels and customer-specific specifications
available on request. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for faster fulfillment to US
destinations.

**Jigchem Universal** **(JC)** is one of the leading Trading Co. catering to the needs of
manufacturer in the field of Bulk Drugs / Chemicals & Solvents / Veterinary & Feed Supplements.

**JC** established in the year 2002 with a focus on quality, commitment and delivery. We have
charted our way to success in our operation and have won the trust & admiration of our customers.

**JC** is founded by team of professionals with more than 30 yrs combined experience of design,
manufacturing, project management, and marketing in the leading local & multinational cos of above
field.

After serving the pharma companies & with all the expertise / relation we are all set to play a role
as an catalyst between the formulator & the marketing companies to get manufacture the product as
per the current compliance and deliver the goods as per the requirement

**VISION:** JC focus is to provide total customer satisfaction & to achieve leadership in the chosen
market, product & service across the globe, through excellence & technology. We will maintain a high
ethical standard in our practice.

**MISSION****:** Jigchem mission is to gain credibility which is known by the factors of
Competitiveness and Reliability. Its mission is also to ensure transparency in each business
transaction along with being a dutiful citizen towards environment.
** ****
****INFRASTRUCTURE:** We have a contemporary office which is fully furnished office, laced with
top-notch communication systems. It is located in the middle of market, allowing us to meet client's
demands timely and efficiently. We have our own warehousing facility situated at Bhiwandi for
storage of material.

**QUALITY ASSURANCE:** We appreciate that maintaining quality standard is a must in every
manufacturing / commercial activity. Therefore we procure our materials from well established ISO
9000 co.s of high reputed customers are provided with specification, samples / COA / MSDS etc as and
when required for efficiently handling the material at plant level. Request for third party
verification ( CSGS / GEO / Nikasu Lab etc ) are gladly accepted. Special attention is paid to
packaging & Transportation to ensure safe delivery without any hassle.

**CLIENT SATISFACTION:** For the last six years we have always placed our customer's interest before
our own. We strive to deliver high quality goods at a competitive price and maintain tight delivery
schedule. Our customers vouch for our transparent and fair dealings and appreciate our sense of
commitment in them. Our clientele is vast and reliable, which is a testimony of our regular growth.

**WHY US ?: **We have been able to establish ourselves as a supplier of choice for the industries we
cater to. Many factors have contributed to our success. Among them are

* **Emphasis on long term relationship building**     │  credit extension**                         
* ** Fair and transparent dealings**                  │* ** Reliable vendor base**                  
                                                      │* ** Proficient workforce**

manufacturer in the field of Bulk Drugs / Chemicals & Solvents / Veterinary & Feed Supplements.

**JC** established in the year 2002 with a focus on quality, commitment and delivery. We have
charted our way to success in our operation and have won the trust & admiration of our customers.

**JC** is founded by team of professionals with more than 30 yrs combined experience of design,
manufacturing, project management, and marketing in the leading local & multinational cos of above
field.

After serving the pharma companies & with all the expertise / relation we are all set to play a role
as an catalyst between the formulator & the marketing companies to get manufacture the product as
per the current compliance and deliver the goods as per the requirement

**VISION:** JC focus is to provide total customer satisfaction & to achieve leadership in the chosen
market, product & service across the globe, through excellence & technology. We will maintain a high
ethical standard in our practice.

**MISSION****:** Jigchem mission is to gain credibility which is known by the factors of
Competitiveness and Reliability. Its mission is also to ensure transparency in each business
transaction along with being a dutiful citizen towards environment.
** ****
****INFRASTRUCTURE:** We have a contemporary office which is fully furnished office, laced with
top-notch communication systems. It is located in the middle of market, allowing us to meet client's
demands timely and efficiently. We have our own warehousing facility situated at Bhiwandi for
storage of material.

**QUALITY ASSURANCE:** We appreciate that maintaining quality standard is a must in every
manufacturing / commercial activity. Therefore we procure our materials from well established ISO
9000 co.s of high reputed customers are provided with specification, samples / COA / MSDS etc as and
when required for efficiently handling the material at plant level. Request for third party
verification ( CSGS / GEO / Nikasu Lab etc ) are gladly accepted. Special attention is paid to
packaging & Transportation to ensure safe delivery without any hassle.

**CLIENT SATISFACTION:** For the last six years we have always placed our customer's interest before
our own. We strive to deliver high quality goods at a competitive price and maintain tight delivery
schedule. Our customers vouch for our transparent and fair dealings and appreciate our sense of
commitment in them. Our clientele is vast and reliable, which is a testimony of our regular growth.

**WHY US ?: **We have been able to establish ourselves as a supplier of choice for the industries we
cater to. Many factors have contributed to our success. Among them are

* ** Fair and transparent dealings**                  │* ** Reliable vendor base**                  
                                                      │* ** Proficient workforce**

# Matangi Industries: A Snapshot

Incorporated in 1993, Matangi Industries is manufacturer of Specialty Chemicals and [Performance
Chemicals][222] with varied end usage. It started as a dyes intermediates manufacturer and later
pivoted into specialty and performance chemicals along with focus on [Custom Synthesis][223] to
serve specific requirements of clients. It currently employs more than 350 people and has a
distribution network that is spread across more than 40 countries around the globe.

## How it works?

Why Medikonda? Gain instant access to 2,000+ ingredients, downloadable QC documents, and
ready-to-use starter formulations, US ready inventory—all in one place.
* ### Instant access to the industry’s most comprehensive catalog
  
  *Browse, search, and filter the USA’s largest food ingredient catalog with ease.*
* ### Order samples, access QC docs, and secure quotes instantly
  
  *The Medikonda Concierge manages all your requests and ensures they’re processed faster than
  ever.*
* ### Real-time inventory, right here in the USA
  
  *Tiered pricing, real-time U.S. inventory, expert food technologist support, and everything you
  need to accelerate product development.*

1 / of 3

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

## How it works?

Why Medikonda? Gain instant access to 2,000+ ingredients, downloadable QC documents, and
ready-to-use starter formulations, US ready inventory—all in one place.
* ### Instant access to the industry’s most comprehensive catalog
  
  *Browse, search, and filter the USA’s largest food ingredient catalog with ease.*
* ### Order samples, access QC docs, and secure quotes instantly
  
  *The Medikonda Concierge manages all your requests and ensures they’re processed faster than
  ever.*
* ### Real-time inventory, right here in the USA
  
  *Tiered pricing, real-time U.S. inventory, expert food technologist support, and everything you
  need to accelerate product development.*

1 / of 3

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

to providing quality in the worldwide marketplace.

We founded our trading company to serve a variety of fatty acids, soap noodles, and glycerin after
MSD Global saw the potential presented by the plentiful supply of palm oil and palm kernel oil in
Malaysia and Indonesia, as well as the preference for vegetable-based oleochemicals in numerous
industries.

Glycerine, soap noodles, and fatty acids derived from palm oil are now commonly available in
international markets. We are now able to supply the United States, Europe, Africa, the Middle East,
and other nations with high-quality Soap Noodles, Palm Oil, Amides And Betaine, Vegetable Fats,
Refined Glycerin and more.

We have partnerships with important sourcing and supply markets in Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand
that create a variety of premium sustainable oleochemicals made from feedstock derived from
vegetables. Our product line includes fatty alcohols, fatty esters, basic fatty acids, and
glycerine. Numerous end-use applications make use of our products.

Green chemicals, sustainable development, and environmental friendliness are the new priorities of
modern society.

MSD Global has had notable expansion. This was made possible by competent management at every level
of our organization, dependable relationships with our manufacturers, andabove allour ability to
handle large volumes of business and provide our clients with high-quality materials. We are
concentrating on new downstream business, supported by a strong confidence in innovation and
thorough market research.

**Vision and Mission**

* To be a leader in providing quality oleochemicals and associated products by meeting customer
  needs through continuous improvement and sustained long-term growth in volume and profitability.
* Our business activities are oleochemicals, speciality fats and edible oil. Our portfolio of
  customers includes personal care, soap & detergent, cosmetics & toiletries, pharmaceuticals, food
  additives, rubber & latex, paints, inks & coatings, candle & waxes, Grease & lubricants, resins,
  animal feed products
* Through our large-volume business integration and logistical advantages of its business model, MSD
  global operates on very sharp margins as well as provides competitive pricing for the benefit of
  its final customers.

**Core Values**

* **Customer Centric- **To be a leading trading company in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To keep abreast of technological developments in the fats & oils production and
  related fields
* **Credibility & Integrity- **We maintain honesty, trustworthiness, and high ethical standards. We
  will continue serving our customers better by setting high standards for our products and people.
  We believe a mutually beneficial relationship serves the cause of long term partnership with our
  customers and manufacturers.
* **Leader-** To be one of the leading trading companies in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To be in tune with technological advancements in the fats & oils production and
  related fields.
* **Focused- **We are Focused and committed to building Real and long lasting Partnerships with all
  our manufacturers and customers, this is critical in achieving sustainability and prolonged
  success.
* **Innovation- **We cherish innovative efforts, ideas, and methods to continue to improve our
  business process. Fresh creative ideas that result in an extended range of products and solutions
  with added value serve as one stop solutions and provide a strong competitive edge for the success
  of our customer and clients.
* **Team Work- **We work as a team to achieve our corporate goal.

**Our Pillars Of Our Success

Reliable Services**

Reliable supply of high-quality goods. Effective worldwide distribution and network supply made
possible by an internal operations and logistics team, as well as extensive customer and product
support. Our logistics and distribution network is extensive. Logistics: We have a dedicated
logistics and operations team that can manage the transportation of huge quantities of containers as
part of our distribution capabilities. Additionally, we have partnerships with the biggest and most
reputable international logistics firms, which enable us to transport materials around the world
with ease.

**Manufacturers**

We aim for greatness. At the core of our business are highly automated, ISO and GMP certified
factories with state-of-the-art facilities that have been thoughtfully designed and built with
functionality in mind. To guarantee quality and worldwide supply continuity, we meticulously oversee
every step of the production, packaging, and logistics planning processes. Modern development labs
run by our manufacturers offer services for testing, product development, and custom formulations.
Our producers are prepared to create innovative goods or enhance the qualities of their current
models. At the heart of all we do is innovation.

**Market Research & Analysis**

We have a unique real-time insight of industry trends because to our extensive client base and
market research department. Understanding the markets they serve and the clients they represent is
the first step in developing a successful marketing plan. With a worldwide viewpoint, MSD worldwide
monitors daily palm oil prices and market trends. To create a comprehensive picture of competition
pricing and product offering, we support our observations with the viewpoints of industry experts.

**Product Positioning**

We are aware of product life cycles and how they relate to consumer needs. We may customize product
qualities based on customer preferences by using a wide variety of oleochemicals.

**Analytical Labs**

MSD worldwide manufacturers follow GMP/FDA guidelines while maintaining testing procedures and
documentation. Moisture, free fatty acid/free alkaline, salt, and active ingredient testing are all
ongoing oleochemical assays.

Testing methods:

* Liquid Chromatographs
* Uv Visible Spectrometer
* Karl Fisher Auto Titrators

**Quality**

Our company always places a high premium on quality assurance, and we take great satisfaction in our
relationships with top manufacturers who adhere to strict QC guidelines. Every production facility
has the most recent standard operating procedure in place and is routinely audited. MSD Global
offers a distinct perspective on specialty fats and oleochemicals. We attain unheard-of control over
our manufacturing by integrating our manufacturer's expertise with the newest systems and
cutting-edge technologies. Our manufacturer's quality advantage is a result of comprehensive testing
of incoming feedstock, computerized process modeling, state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment, and
diligent employees. Our top-tier quality processes are acknowledged by our esteemed clients
worldwide.

* Our business activities are oleochemicals, speciality fats and edible oil. Our portfolio of
  customers includes personal care, soap & detergent, cosmetics & toiletries, pharmaceuticals, food
  additives, rubber & latex, paints, inks & coatings, candle & waxes, Grease & lubricants, resins,
  animal feed products
* Through our large-volume business integration and logistical advantages of its business model, MSD
  global operates on very sharp margins as well as provides competitive pricing for the benefit of
  its final customers.

**Core Values**

* **Customer Centric- **To be a leading trading company in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To keep abreast of technological developments in the fats & oils production and
  related fields
* **Credibility & Integrity- **We maintain honesty, trustworthiness, and high ethical standards. We
  will continue serving our customers better by setting high standards for our products and people.
  We believe a mutually beneficial relationship serves the cause of long term partnership with our
  customers and manufacturers.
* **Leader-** To be one of the leading trading companies in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To be in tune with technological advancements in the fats & oils production and
  related fields.
* **Focused- **We are Focused and committed to building Real and long lasting Partnerships with all
  our manufacturers and customers, this is critical in achieving sustainability and prolonged
  success.
* **Innovation- **We cherish innovative efforts, ideas, and methods to continue to improve our
  business process. Fresh creative ideas that result in an extended range of products and solutions
  with added value serve as one stop solutions and provide a strong competitive edge for the success
  of our customer and clients.
* **Team Work- **We work as a team to achieve our corporate goal.

**Our Pillars Of Our Success

Reliable Services**

Reliable supply of high-quality goods. Effective worldwide distribution and network supply made
possible by an internal operations and logistics team, as well as extensive customer and product
support. Our logistics and distribution network is extensive. Logistics: We have a dedicated
logistics and operations team that can manage the transportation of huge quantities of containers as
part of our distribution capabilities. Additionally, we have partnerships with the biggest and most
reputable international logistics firms, which enable us to transport materials around the world
with ease.

**Manufacturers**

We aim for greatness. At the core of our business are highly automated, ISO and GMP certified
factories with state-of-the-art facilities that have been thoughtfully designed and built with
functionality in mind. To guarantee quality and worldwide supply continuity, we meticulously oversee
every step of the production, packaging, and logistics planning processes. Modern development labs
run by our manufacturers offer services for testing, product development, and custom formulations.
Our producers are prepared to create innovative goods or enhance the qualities of their current
models. At the heart of all we do is innovation.

**Market Research & Analysis**

We have a unique real-time insight of industry trends because to our extensive client base and
market research department. Understanding the markets they serve and the clients they represent is
the first step in developing a successful marketing plan. With a worldwide viewpoint, MSD worldwide
monitors daily palm oil prices and market trends. To create a comprehensive picture of competition
pricing and product offering, we support our observations with the viewpoints of industry experts.

**Product Positioning**

We are aware of product life cycles and how they relate to consumer needs. We may customize product
qualities based on customer preferences by using a wide variety of oleochemicals.

**Analytical Labs**

MSD worldwide manufacturers follow GMP/FDA guidelines while maintaining testing procedures and
documentation. Moisture, free fatty acid/free alkaline, salt, and active ingredient testing are all
ongoing oleochemical assays.

Testing methods:

* Liquid Chromatographs
* Uv Visible Spectrometer
* Karl Fisher Auto Titrators

**Quality**

Our company always places a high premium on quality assurance, and we take great satisfaction in our
relationships with top manufacturers who adhere to strict QC guidelines. Every production facility
has the most recent standard operating procedure in place and is routinely audited. MSD Global
offers a distinct perspective on specialty fats and oleochemicals. We attain unheard-of control over
our manufacturing by integrating our manufacturer's expertise with the newest systems and
cutting-edge technologies. Our manufacturer's quality advantage is a result of comprehensive testing
of incoming feedstock, computerized process modeling, state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment, and
diligent employees. Our top-tier quality processes are acknowledged by our esteemed clients
worldwide.

## About Niran Biochemical

Niran Biochemical is a global supplier of specialty and bulk chemicals, providing raw material
solutions for industrial, personal care, and cleaning product manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global manufacturing and supplier
network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of detergent chemicals, personal care ingredients, water
treatment chemicals, and industrial chemicals, supporting consistent quality, formulation
performance, and stability across diverse applications, including liquid and powder detergents,
shampoos, cleaners, industrial processes, and specialty manufacturing.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

## About Niran Biochemical

Niran Biochemical is a global supplier of specialty and bulk chemicals, providing raw material
solutions for industrial, personal care, and cleaning product manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global manufacturing and supplier
network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of detergent chemicals, personal care ingredients, water
treatment chemicals, and industrial chemicals, supporting consistent quality, formulation
performance, and stability across diverse applications, including liquid and powder detergents,
shampoos, cleaners, industrial processes, and specialty manufacturing.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

линейке OMM BLAT:**

Нежный нюд, который подстраивается под естественный оттенок губ. Визуально добавляет объем, освежает

линейку OMM BLAT вслед за Candy Matcha и стал самым универсальным оттенком коллекции на каждый день.

напоминает о другом: можно быть мягкой, заботливой к себе и позволять себе маленькие радости без
чувства вины.

Нанеси небольшое количество на центр верхней и нижней губы.

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.
[ CONTACT US > ][58]

[CREMER North America Logistics and Global Supply]

# CREMER North America

# is your regional oleochemical supplier with a global reach

Our global network grants you access to oleochemical supplies, contract manufacturing, and
end-to-end solutions that help you improve your outcomes and reduce manufacturing costs.

CREMER has three North American facilities for oleochemical supply and manufacturing services
accessible throughout the United States and beyond. Extend your internal manufacturing capabilities
and drive growth with CREMER.
[CREMER NA has three locations in Ohio, Tennessee and Louisiana.]
[ Speak with a CREMER expert > ][37]

# INDUSTRIES WE SERVE

Our solutions provide the highest quality oleochemical supplies, toll manufacturing or end-to-end
services for global markets across these services and more. Let us know how we can help you.
Pet Care, Food & Treats
Personal Care & Cosmetics
Household & Industrial Cleaning
Adhesives. Sealings & Coatings
Lubricants & Greases
Food & Beverage
Pharmaceuticals
Agriculture
Rubber & Plastic Additives
Oil & Gas
[ CONTACT US > ][38]

# OLEOCHEMICALS WE SUPPLY

We provide kosher, non-kosher, and food-safe oleochemicals in volumes ranging from drum to tote to
tanker.
[ Oleochemicals ][39] [ Fatty Acids ][40] [ Fatty Alcohols ][41] [ Glycerin & Propylene Glycol ][42]
[ Methyl Esters ][43] [ Soap Noodles ][44]
[ CONTACT US > ][45]

# MANUFACTURING SOLUTIONS

We hold our manufacturing, logistics, and lab services to the highest standards to stay compliant
with our various certifications. We assess each manufacturing run and logistics plan to ensure
efficiency and sustainability in everything we do.
[ Contract Manufacturing ][46] [ Pastillation & Flaking ][47] [ Drumming & Toting ][48] [ Blending &
Diluting ][49] [ warehousing & Storage ][50] [ Lab Services ][51] [ Logistics ][52]
[ CONTACT US > ][53]

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.
[ CONTACT US > ][58]

# онлайн и бесплатно

Умный анализатор ингредиентов (INCI).
Найдем токсины, аллергены и маркетинговые уловки за 1 секунду.

Вставить пример
Проверить состав Анализируем... [ Фото ][8]
Поддерживаем английские (INCI) и русские названия.

*                

## Как проверить состав косметики за 4 шага

01

### Скопируйте

Найдите список Ingredients (INCI) на сайте магазина или упаковке.

02

### Вставьте

Поместите текст в поле анализатора или загрузите четкое фото этикетки.

03

### Запустите

Нажмите кнопку «Проверить». AI сопоставит данные с базой токсичности.

04

### Узнайте правду

Получите отчет о безопасности, аллергенах и реальной пользе активов.

## Преимущества сервиса

### Научная база

Анализ основан на данных CIR (Cosmetic Ingredient Review) и регламентах безопасности ЕС.

### 15 000+ компонентов

Нейросеть обучена на крупнейшей базе косметической химии и постоянно обновляется.

### Независимость

Нет сотрудничества с брендами. Вердикт всегда объективен и основан только на фактах.

## Глоссарий вредных ингредиентов

Краткий справочник веществ, которые наш анализатор помечает как нежелательные.

### Парабены (Parabens)

Консерванты (Methylparaben, Propylparaben). Могут имитировать действие эстрогена и вызывать
гормональные сбои.

### Сульфаты (SLS/SLES)

Агрессивные ПАВ. Разрушают защитный барьер кожи, вызывают сухость, раздражение и шелушение.

### Минеральное масло

Продукт нефтепереработки (Paraffinum Liquidum). Создает пленку, которая может забивать поры
(комедогенность).

### Силиконы (Silicones)

Dimethicone, Cyclomethicone. Дают временный эффект гладкости, но плохо смываются и накапливаются на
коже.

### Спирт (Alcohol Denat)

Простой спирт в начале состава сильно сушит кожу и повреждает липидный слой, провоцируя жирность.

### Фталаты (Phthalates)

Используются для фиксации аромата. Считаются потенциальными канцерогенами и токсинами для
репродуктивной системы.

Маркетинг vs Реальность

## Что скрывает
## красивая упаковка?

Бренд может написать "Органик" и "Экстракт черной икры", даже если икры там меньше 0.01%.

Сервис игнорирует лицевую этикетку. Учитывается только **INCI** — международный список ингредиентов.
Химия не умеет врать.

## Как проверить состав косметики за 4 шага

01

### Скопируйте

Найдите список Ingredients (INCI) на сайте магазина или упаковке.

02

### Вставьте

Поместите текст в поле анализатора или загрузите четкое фото этикетки.

03

### Запустите

Нажмите кнопку «Проверить». AI сопоставит данные с базой токсичности.

04

### Узнайте правду

Получите отчет о безопасности, аллергенах и реальной пользе активов.

## Преимущества сервиса

### Научная база

Анализ основан на данных CIR (Cosmetic Ingredient Review) и регламентах безопасности ЕС.

### 15 000+ компонентов

Нейросеть обучена на крупнейшей базе косметической химии и постоянно обновляется.

### Независимость

Нет сотрудничества с брендами. Вердикт всегда объективен и основан только на фактах.

## Глоссарий вредных ингредиентов

Краткий справочник веществ, которые наш анализатор помечает как нежелательные.

### Парабены (Parabens)

Консерванты (Methylparaben, Propylparaben). Могут имитировать действие эстрогена и вызывать
гормональные сбои.

### Сульфаты (SLS/SLES)

Агрессивные ПАВ. Разрушают защитный барьер кожи, вызывают сухость, раздражение и шелушение.

### Минеральное масло

Продукт нефтепереработки (Paraffinum Liquidum). Создает пленку, которая может забивать поры
(комедогенность).

### Силиконы (Silicones)

Dimethicone, Cyclomethicone. Дают временный эффект гладкости, но плохо смываются и накапливаются на
коже.

### Спирт (Alcohol Denat)

Простой спирт в начале состава сильно сушит кожу и повреждает липидный слой, провоцируя жирность.

### Фталаты (Phthalates)

Используются для фиксации аромата. Считаются потенциальными канцерогенами и токсинами для
репродуктивной системы.

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

### Jak działa analizator składu ciała **SafetyMakeup**?

Najważniejsze jest to, że aby przeczytać ze zrozumieniem INCI, niemusicie uczyć się łacińskich i
angielskich nazw składników. Stronainternetowa Safetymakeup analizują skład kosmetyków.
Podkreślądobre i złe komponenty, a przy okazji opisują je.

#### Poziom bezpieczeństwa

Zgodnie z oceną BIODIZIONARIO, etyczny projekt VEGANOK Srl SocietàBenefit, którego celem jest
szerzenie umiarkowanej i świadomejkonsumpcji. Od prawie 20 lat standard najczęściej stosowany
wsektorze eko-kosmetyków. Ma 5 ocen: Całkiem bezpiecznie,Bezpiecznie, Dopuszczalny, Średnie
bezpiecznie, Jest zastrzeżenie.

#### Poziom EWG

The Environmental Working Group - 30-milionowa społecznośćdziałająca na rzecz ochrony naszego
środowiska poprzez zmianęstandardów branżowych. Od 1993 roku Environmental Working Groupzwraca uwagę
na przestarzałe przepisy, szkodliwe praktykirolnicze i luki przemysłowe, które stanowią zagrożenie
dlanaszego zdrowia i środowiska. Każdy produkt jest oceniany przy użyciu czynników obliczonych na
podstawie prawie 60 zintegrowanych baz danych dotyczącychtoksyczności, wymogów prawnych i
dostępności badań.

Oceny według oceny EWG: od 1 do 10.

#### Nazwa składnika

Usługa oparta jest na bazie tysięcy składników wraz z ocenami i krótkim opisem zgodnie ze
standardami INCI. INCI jest skrótem od nazwy International Nomenclatur e of Cosmetic Ingredients
(Międzynarodowe Nazewnictwo Składników Kosmetycznych). Określa zbiór substancji, które wymieniane są
na etykiecie produktu z napisem "Ingridients" lub "Składniki". Funkcja w produkcie są wskazane pod
nazwą.

Kluczowe cechy: Zapachowe, Emolienty, Humektanty.

#### Opis składnika

Obejmuje główne właściwości składnika i działanie, jakie kieruje na skórę.

### Jak działa analizator składu ciała **SafetyMakeup**?

Najważniejsze jest to, że aby przeczytać ze zrozumieniem INCI, niemusicie uczyć się łacińskich i
angielskich nazw składników. Stronainternetowa Safetymakeup analizują skład kosmetyków.
Podkreślądobre i złe komponenty, a przy okazji opisują je.

#### Poziom bezpieczeństwa

Zgodnie z oceną BIODIZIONARIO, etyczny projekt VEGANOK Srl SocietàBenefit, którego celem jest
szerzenie umiarkowanej i świadomejkonsumpcji. Od prawie 20 lat standard najczęściej stosowany
wsektorze eko-kosmetyków. Ma 5 ocen: Całkiem bezpiecznie,Bezpiecznie, Dopuszczalny, Średnie
bezpiecznie, Jest zastrzeżenie.

#### Poziom EWG

The Environmental Working Group - 30-milionowa społecznośćdziałająca na rzecz ochrony naszego
środowiska poprzez zmianęstandardów branżowych. Od 1993 roku Environmental Working Groupzwraca uwagę
na przestarzałe przepisy, szkodliwe praktykirolnicze i luki przemysłowe, które stanowią zagrożenie
dlanaszego zdrowia i środowiska. Każdy produkt jest oceniany przy użyciu czynników obliczonych na
podstawie prawie 60 zintegrowanych baz danych dotyczącychtoksyczności, wymogów prawnych i
dostępności badań.

Oceny według oceny EWG: od 1 do 10.

#### Nazwa składnika

Usługa oparta jest na bazie tysięcy składników wraz z ocenami i krótkim opisem zgodnie ze
standardami INCI. INCI jest skrótem od nazwy International Nomenclatur e of Cosmetic Ingredients
(Międzynarodowe Nazewnictwo Składników Kosmetycznych). Określa zbiór substancji, które wymieniane są
na etykiecie produktu z napisem "Ingridients" lub "Składniki". Funkcja w produkcie są wskazane pod
nazwą.

Kluczowe cechy: Zapachowe, Emolienty, Humektanty.

#### Opis składnika

Obejmuje główne właściwości składnika i działanie, jakie kieruje na skórę.

Strategic U.S. stock locations and dedicated inventories minimize risk and lead times. Our global

### Supplying Critical Materials Across North America’s Most Demanding Markets

Silver Fern supports manufacturers across a wide range of specialty and industrial markets, from
plastics, coatings, and adhesives to agriculture, food processing, energy, and advanced
manufacturing. Our strength is understanding how material requirements change by application,
regulation, and supply chain risk, and positioning inventory, sourcing, and technical support
accordingly.

Whether you need a reliable core raw material or a hard-to-source specialty input, we help ensure
continuity, compliance, and confidence across every market we serve.

  type). At the same time, it is still non-cytotoxic at high concentrations and is suitable for

  A Alpha arbutin (α-arbutin) and beta arbutin (β-arbutin) are two common cosmetic whitening
  ingredients. Although they belong to the arbutin family, they have significant differences in
  structure, stability, effect and safety. Although both inhibit tyrosinase activity and block
  melanin production, thereby reducing pigment deposition and achieving whitening and freckle
  removal effects, alpha arbutin is resistant to high temperatures (no decomposition at 100°C), acid
  and alkali (stable at pH 5.2-8.0), and has good light stability. It inhibits tyrosinase activity
  10-15 times that of the β type. It can be effective at low concentrations (about 1/9 of the β
  type). At the same time, it is still non-cytotoxic at high concentrations and is suitable for
  long-term use.

Vidmate app is a free video downloader for Android that works with many different social platforms,
including YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp, among others.



With Vidmate, you'll be able to download any multimedia material (videos, pictures, or audio files)
to your Android device at no cost. Just with a couple of taps, you can get that amazing YouTube
music video, useful Facebook tutorials, or popular TikTok recipes or choreographies in just a few
seconds. With this amazing feature, you'll be able to play them later without using any allowance of
your data plan. This is a great way of saving data and money while having your favorite content
available at all times.



Once you download the Vidmate app, you'll realize it's compatible with a lot of different and
popular platforms, including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp Status, Dailymotion, Vimeo,
Twitter, LiveLeak, Instagram... You've got almost everything. Also, Vidmate works on Internet
browsers, so feel free to watch, enjoy and download your favorite content directly from your
browser.



Vidmate is an extremely easy-to-use tool. You'll realize that a tutorial is not needed and, once you
download it and open it, you'll easily understand the way Vidmate works and you'll start downloading
videos, pictures, and songs in a matter of seconds. The experience is so smooth that you can
download several videos at the same time. This way you'll save some time and, as said, a lot of data
from your mobile data plan! You can also, pause and resume the download process in case you're Wi-Fi
connection is interrupted for any reason. These downloads take place in the background, but you'll
always be able to check the progress at any time.



The amount of formats you can download videos on is amazing, from lower-resolution 2K clips to
amazing 4K ones, Vidmate will for sure meet your quality requirements and adapt to your needs. This
option is not only crucial for you to manage your device memory but also to enjoy the content in the
best way possible on your device. Vidmate offers an automatic system to adjust videos to best suit
your screen size. This way you can relax and let Vidmate make this decision for you!



Vidmate app also works with other types of content apart from videos, including pictures and audio.
You can download high-resolution pictures and memes very quickly but also songs in a lot of formats,
including mp3! If you were worried about using too much data to listen to your favorite playlist,
you can just download those songs at a very high speed via WiFi to enjoy them without using your
allowance!



Your favorite YouTube video downloader is not only easy-to-use, comfortable, convenient, and fast,
but also a safe tool. With Vidmate you'll enjoy amazing features to download your favorite content
to your Android device while keeping it safe at all times. And it's also free to download and use!



Vidmate also features a subscribe option that allows you to follow content that you like and to keep
you updated with your favorite influencers and Internet stars. Also, if you need new ideas, you can
just use the Discover channel and find out the latest trends around the globe!



On top of all those social media platforms, Vidmate app also offers you the possibility to record
Live TV and series, including very popular channels such as Zee TV and Channel V, in a lot of
languages and from all over the world.



One of the most useful and popular tools on the internet is waiting for you! Download Vidmate to get
your favorite videos to your Android device in minutes easily and comfortably!

videos, pictures, and songs in a matter of seconds. The experience is so smooth that you can
download several videos at the same time. This way you'll save some time and, as said, a lot of data
from your mobile data plan! You can also, pause and resume the download process in case you're Wi-Fi
connection is interrupted for any reason. These downloads take place in the background, but you'll
always be able to check the progress at any time.



The amount of formats you can download videos on is amazing, from lower-resolution 2K clips to
amazing 4K ones, Vidmate will for sure meet your quality requirements and adapt to your needs. This
option is not only crucial for you to manage your device memory but also to enjoy the content in the
best way possible on your device. Vidmate offers an automatic system to adjust videos to best suit
your screen size. This way you can relax and let Vidmate make this decision for you!



Vidmate app also works with other types of content apart from videos, including pictures and audio.
You can download high-resolution pictures and memes very quickly but also songs in a lot of formats,
including mp3! If you were worried about using too much data to listen to your favorite playlist,
you can just download those songs at a very high speed via WiFi to enjoy them without using your
allowance!



Your favorite YouTube video downloader is not only easy-to-use, comfortable, convenient, and fast,
but also a safe tool. With Vidmate you'll enjoy amazing features to download your favorite content
to your Android device while keeping it safe at all times. And it's also free to download and use!



Vidmate also features a subscribe option that allows you to follow content that you like and to keep
you updated with your favorite influencers and Internet stars. Also, if you need new ideas, you can
just use the Discover channel and find out the latest trends around the globe!



On top of all those social media platforms, Vidmate app also offers you the possibility to record
Live TV and series, including very popular channels such as Zee TV and Channel V, in a lot of
languages and from all over the world.



One of the most useful and popular tools on the internet is waiting for you! Download Vidmate to get
your favorite videos to your Android device in minutes easily and comfortably!
